title: Article economic-data.json
description: Per-article artefact produced by agentic workflows during the pre-article analysis phase. Bridges World Bank / SCB MCP tool output into the Chart.js-powered 'Economic Context' dashboard emitted by `scripts/data-transformers/content-generators/economic-dashboard-section.ts`. Written to `analysis/daily/YYYY-MM-DD/{analysisSubfolder}/economic-data.json`.

articleType.description: Article type slug the context was produced for (e.g. 'committee-reports').

policyDomains.description: Policy domains detected from the source documents (e.g. 'fiscal policy', 'defence', 'labor market'). Fed to `findIndicatorsForDomains`.

dataPoints.description: World Bank data points (may be empty only when `skip` is true).

commentary.description: AI-authored commentary paragraph (2–4 sentences) that cites 2–3 concrete values from `dataPoints`. Rendered as the dashboard section summary.

source.description: Attribution sources the workflow actually queried.

skip.description: Set to true only for article types on the exempt allow-list (e.g. pure-process realtime monitor stories). `dataPoints` may be empty when this is true.

skipReason.description: Brief free-form reason when skip=true (required by the validator allow-list).

value.description: Numeric value of the indicator for the country/date.
